detail: Baton needs every document M02's kickoff prompt names to be on main, because the session is told to read them and its worktree is created from main. It names docs/nowhere.md, which main does not have. Write or restore that document, then commit it on main: git -C '@TMP@/Fixture' add -- 'docs/nowhere.md' && git -C '@TMP@/Fixture' commit -m 'Record docs/nowhere.md'
